import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric, handling negative and out-of-range values
    df = df.copy()
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    # Standardize sex labels
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Filter out out-of-range body_mass_g values
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned_df = clean(df)
    avg_flipper_length = cleaned_df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    return avg_flipper_length
